title: Observability: token-level KV metrics + tracing dashboard and alert tuning
author: Priya Sharma
release_notes: Adds token-level KV cache metrics and enhanced tracing to the Observability dashboard; tunes alerts to reduce noise while preserving SLO coverage.
description: Motivation: production workloads have been showing intermittent spikes in per-token cost and elevated tail latency that correlate with KV cache churn. This PR adds token-level KV cache metrics, integrates KV spans into the existing request tracing, updates Grafana dashboards, and tunes alerts to reduce false positives while maintaining operational coverage. Scope: 1) New Prometheus metrics: redwood_kv_cache_tokens_total, redwood_kv_cache_hit_rate_by_token, redwood_kv_kv_evictions_rate_by_model. 2) Tracing: attach KV op spans to request traces and add trace attributes (kv_key_count, kv_hit_ratio, model_variant). 3) Dashboards: token-level cost/latency panel, KV hit-rate heatmap, per-model token cost breakdown, and combined trace links. 4) Alerts: move from a single global token-cost alert to tiered alerts (model-level P99 token latency, KV hit-rate drop sustained over 5min, unexpected evictions). Checklist: - Implement metrics and exposition (Prom client) - Wire metrics into existing ingestion pipelines - Instrument KV codepaths with trace spans - Add Grafana panels and dashboard JSON - Adjust alert rules and add runbook notes - Add unit tests for metric labels and e2e smoke for tracing Changes: See files_changed for details. Backwards compatibility: all new metrics are additive and respect existing metric names. Rollout plan: staged rollout behind a feature flag, enable dashboards read-only for SRE, then flip feature flag after 48h of green CI and low alert noise. Related: ENG-5421 (investigation), incident-2025-10-29 (high-cost tail).

review_conversation: Evan Liu: Left a few inline comments about metric cardinality and label choices. Please ensure model_id is limited to a stable set.
Priya Sharma: Addressed Evan's comments by changing model_id -> model_family label and adding a sanitization step. Updated tests.
Maya Patel: Question on alert thresholds for p99 token latency. Can we prefer percent change relative to baseline rather than absolute ms?
Priya Sharma: Updated alert to use percentage increase over 7d baseline for model-level P99 and kept absolute fallback for global tier. Added note in runbook.
Diego Fernández: Verified Grafana panels render and trace links open correctly in staging. Approved.
SRE bot: CI checks passed. All required approvals present.
merge_summary: Squash-merged after approvals and green CI. All changes behind feature flag token_kv_metrics. Deployed to staging and rolled to prod after 24h with no alert regressions.
notes_post_merge: Enable feature flag phased: 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 24h; monitor new token-level panels and adjust alert thresholds if noise increases. SRE to run the runbook on first KV hit-rate incident.
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: adding high-cardinality labels could increase Prom storage and query cost. Mitigation: use model_family label and sanitize keys; metrics are exposed with drop_high_cardinality=true behind flag initially. Also added retention guidance in runbook.
test_plan: Unit tests for metric label normalization, integration tests that verify metrics appear in scrape endpoint, e2e smoke test that traces include KV spans and Grafana link, and manual verification of dashboard rendering in staging.
